capabilities: Show hint labels over clickable elements via the 'Show click hints' command
Navigate to links and buttons by typing the displayed hint characters
Highlight partial matches as hint characters are typed
Configure which characters are used for hints (default a-z)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to navigate to arbitrary clickable elements like links and buttons using only the keyboard.

relations.evidence: mrjackphil/obsidian-jump-to-link: Quick jump between links using hotkeys

summary: Keyboard-driven hint overlay that lets users jump to any clickable element, such as links and buttons, by typing hint characters.
